blind_rule: No upstream lpass-tx-macro.c was read or used.

patch_series.title: ASoC: codecs: lpass-tx-macro: isolate register-name migration
patch_series.scope: Move file to sound/soc/codecs/lpass-tx-macro.c, localize header-backed LPASS_CDC_TX register defines as CDC_TX, remove lpass-cdc-registers.h.

patch_series.title: ASoC: codecs: lpass-tx-macro: drop version and unused pinctrl paths
patch_series.scope: Remove linux/version.h, LINUX_VERSION_CODE compatibility branches by keeping current-kernel branch, and remove unused msm-cdc-pinctrl include.

patch_series.title: ASoC: codecs: lpass-tx-macro: remove lpass-cdc macro framework dependency
patch_series.scope: Replace macro_ops/register/unregister/device-pointer indirection with devm_snd_soc_register_component and direct private data.

patch_series.title: ASoC: codecs: lpass-tx-macro: own MMIO regmap in probe
patch_series.scope: Introduce tx_macro private data, devm_platform_ioremap_resource/devm_regmap_init_mmio, and remove parent regmap usage.

patch_series.title: ASoC: codecs: lpass-macro-common: integrate TX power domains
patch_series.scope: Use lpass_macro_pds_init/exit with TX as immediate consumer.

patch_series.title: ASoC: codecs: lpass-tx-macro: migrate clock and runtime PM sequencing
patch_series.scope: Replace lpass-cdc-clk-rsc with direct clock APIs and local fsgen/mclk helpers; add runtime PM callbacks.

patch_series.title: ASoC: codecs: lpass-tx-macro: add SoC data model
patch_series.scope: Introduce tx_macro_data and per-compatible flags inferred from downstream version/BOLERO capability gates.

patch_series.title: ASoC: codecs: lpass-tx-macro: reduce downstream DAPM topology
patch_series.scope: Remove/downscope downstream-only controls, SWR_DMIC policy controls, BCS/adapt controls unless binding and users are justified.

patch_series.title: ASoC: codecs: lpass-tx-macro: residual cleanup and naming normalization
patch_series.scope: Normalize lpass_cdc_tx_macro/LPASS_CDC_TX_MACRO local names, defer DT compatible changes fail-closed if SoC evidence is missing.

lessons_applied.tx_plan: Probe must own struct regmap * via devm_regmap_init_mmio; parent regmap use is a known conversion gap.
Because TX manipulates MCLK/FS counter gates, plan a clock-provider assessment and fail closed until binding evidence confirms exported clocks.
Introduce tx_macro_data for BOLERO/version feature conditionals instead of preserving downstream Kconfig gates.
Do not preserve all downstream DAPM routes by default; reduce or justify BCS/adapt/SWR-DMIC controls.
tx_macro struct must own dev, regmap, clocks, pds, component, and feature flags directly.

tx_specific_challenges: TX has 8 decimators versus VA 4, increasing DAPM/control surface.
TX has BCS, HPF adapt, tuning-register arrays, and SWR_DMIC gain controls that need upstream ABI review.
TX has qcom,tx-dmic-clk-div-factor downstream DT property; must map to a standard sample-rate/data model or defer.
TX probe depends on lpass_cdc_is_va_macro_registered; replacing this dependency without upstream TX reference is non-trivial.
BOLERO_VER_2P85 and BOLERO_VER_4P0 gates encode feature variants; blind conversion should map them to SoC data flags later.
blind_assumptions: CDC_TX_* is the correct local register prefix by analogy to VA CDC_VA_*.
TX should follow LPASS macro component registration and private regmap ownership conventions from VA lessons.
TX may need clock-provider plumbing if binding evidence later shows clock-output-names or exported fsgen-like outputs.
The current-kernel branch of LINUX_VERSION_CODE conditionals is the branch to preserve.
Downstream BOLERO Kconfig blocks are not removed in the first two blind patches because topology impact cannot be proven without upstream evidence.
